title: Document the authenticated executor wake route and asynchronous receipt contract
outcome: Document the authenticated executor wake route and asynchronous receipt contract
acceptance: The feature brief names /federation/v1/executor/wake, bounded request/receipt metadata and 202/409/429 semantics, stating that 202 proves Received only and queue/effect evidence follows independently in owned work.
Independent review confirms the route/status/ownership description matches production and explains the current remoteWakeDelivery capability meaning without claiming the whole M4 parent complete.
